events.title: Pell the lamplighter
events.text:
A FRIENDLY WORD
Pell the lamplighter

Pell lowers his pole and leans down to your skiff. "Heard something on my rounds. Tomorrow: Warehouses flooded at Saint Mire. Moon Ink dumped at cost before it spoils."

Pell thinks it likely. Rumours like this land in full about half the time. About 1 in 5 turns the other way.
If it holds, tomorrow at Saint Mire: buy Moon Ink there. It is one night away, so you can be there when it lands. Either way, you will hear what really happened.
Continue
